author: 2k_115
text: CVE-2026-35273: Critical Oracle PeopleSoft flaw (CVSS 9.8). Unauthenticated SSRF leads to RCE. Exploited as a zero-day by ShinyHunters since May, hitting universities hard. Patch now and don't rely only on WAFs.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Two MCP clients fixed sign-in flaws that let a malicious MCP server run commands on your machine: MCP Inspector (update to 2.12.0, or 1.0.3 on the 1.x line) and OpenCode on Windows/WSL (1.18.33+). Neither fix has a CVE.

author: BXAR_Sec
text: Google Threat Intelligence Group: 50% of likely AI-discovered vulnerabilities led to remote code execution, against 26% for other CVEs. Monthly CVE disclosures roughly doubled in 2026.

author: sjandfun
text: Check Point found fake 'GPT-6 Astra' and 'Claude Opus' desktop apps on GitHub pages ranking in Google search; each bundles a real signed OpenAI or Claude installer with a malicious crypto-miner payload.

author: immunisense
text: PingCAP TiDB Cloud breach started with one compromised GitHub account; the attacker used keys and tokens in private repos and Terraform state to get into Google Cloud, Jira and internal chat (per NebuSec).

author: NewsTongueX
text: Bithumb, South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange, disclosed a breach of its internal employee mobile system; no crypto funds reported lost. 38K Daishin customers hit in a Seoul cyber wave.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Trojanized LiteLLM 1.107.0 pushed to PyPI and Docker on Oct 21 hooks Python startup to steal credentials; the supply chain attack traced to a months-old unrotated key that gave attackers full CI/CD control.

author: TheHackersNews
text: Google patches 52 Chrome security flaws, including 4 critical bugs. Claude AI discovered dozens of Chrome vulnerabilities, built a working multi-stage exploit chain, and escaped Chrome's browser sandbox to execute code.

author: CyberScoopNews
text: Alarm bells ratcheted up again about an AI-discovered vulnerability that could destabilize vast stretches of the internet: critical CVE-2026-111497 in the Google-developed Brotli decompression library.

author: AiRiskBytes
text: From first contact to privileged cloud access in under three hours; the attacker was a fleet of agents. Microsoft named the actor behind the ConnectWise supply-chain attack: a China-aligned group running ARTEX, an open-source AI pen-testing framework.

author: morphisec
text: Storm-0940 (China) used ARTEX agentic AI to weaponize ConnectWise supply chain attack, 2,900 sign-in failures per minute. Microsoft formally attributed the ConnectWise Cloud Backup attack.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: AI-assisted extortion operation n0n hit 93 victims, demanded $283.7M total, and ran its entire attack toolkit through an LLM coding agent.

author: GlazeScanHQ
text: CVE-2026-115413 (High): AWS API MCP Server accepted auth tokens issued to other apps in the same account. Fixed in 1.6.0.

author: nullptr_sh
text: opencode on Windows/WSL: a remote MCP server can RCE you during OAuth. No CVE. Fixed in 1.18.33; affected 1.0.137-1.18.32.

author: nullptr_sh
text: VS Code + Copilot: agent could silently edit custom hook files; prompt injection to shell in a hook. Fix: VS Code 1.141.1 (CVE-2026-102232).

author: david_x_ai
text: Flowise CSV and Airtable agents ran LLM-written Python after a regex blocklist check; bypass in one line (CVE-2026-73487, fixed in 3.1.3).

author: WuRichard_
text: NVIDIA count across 31,132 agent skills: 26.1% vulnerable, 5.2% likely malicious intent.

author: AiRiskBytes
text: A security firm found a malicious AGENTS.md file in a customer's Downloads folder; the AI coding agent read it as instructions.

author: Dekrov_Dev
text: 42 real GitHub repositories weaponized with AI-tool autorun hooks; JFrog found malicious triggers for Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor and VS Code.

author: SendTechtimes
text: JFrog identified compromised repositories carrying developer-tool execution hooks and concealed payloads, with stolen credentials linking npm releases to further repository attacks.

author: PexlensX
text: LiteLLM v1.107.0 was compromised on PyPI. Attackers hijacked the release pipeline and pointed it at a lookalike repo Berri-AI/litellm.

author: Gurucul
text: The LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply chain attack deployed an infostealer targeting cloud credentials, AI API keys, SSH keys and developer secrets via malicious Python startup files.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Aokigahara infostealer adds collection routines targeting local AI coding assistants (Claude, Codex, Cursor) plus Git, SSH and cloud credentials.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: Warp discloses breach of agent traces and user telemetry via a vendor in its infrastructure; roughly 1% of users may be affected. Rotate any API keys pasted into Warp AI.

author: _pksharma
text: Warp CEO: an active and narrow-banded exploitation of a vendor in Warp's infrastructure; roughly 1% of Warp users may have been impacted.

author: TheHackersNews
text: CISA adds two actively exploited flaws in Adobe Commerce/Magento (PolyShell, hundreds of stores breached) and Google Brotli (Node2Shell) to its KEV catalog.

author: gettransilience
text: CVE-2026-111497 (CVSS 9.2) actively exploited and in CISA KEV: out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli decoder affecting Node.js, Python, .NET, Bun, Envoy and Istio.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical Adobe Commerce unrestricted file upload to RCE, actively exploited (CVE-2026-48356).

author: defango
text: PHP2Shell: two critical PHP bugs (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2) allow unauthenticated code execution; CISA lists them as actively exploited.

author: rishikagupta__
text: PHP2Shell: unauthenticated RCE hitting PHP-FPM and mod_php, actively exploited per CISA. Fix: 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12.

author: WorldCyberNewsX
text: Positive Technologies flags two actively exploited flaws: CVE-2026-85880 in Windows ALPC and critical CVE-2026-85102 in Check Point Security Gateway VPN; both added to CISA KEV.

author: so_sthbryan
text: CISA added CVE-2026-110447 in Collabora Online CODE Server (CVSS 9.2) and a critical Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator RCE to KEV; both actively exploited.

author: infrastack_ai
text: StyleSmuggler: CVE-2026-75650, template engine injection in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, CVSS 10.0, actively exploited.

author: 2Workly
text: Apple backported fixes for actively exploited CoreGraphics flaw CVE-2026-86950 to iOS 18.7.11.

author: SecureChap
text: GMO Onamae Desktop Cloud intrusion on 20 October left MT4/MT5 credentials on up to 26,739 servers exposed after malware landed.

author: eddysayshi_x
text: PingCAP Cloud October 2026 incident: stolen credentials, exposed data, TiDB databases stayed secure.

author: beincrypto
text: Coinbase denies breach: a security incident at analytics vendor Amplitude exposed contact data of a small subset of Coinbase customers.

author: security_score
text: Two TeamPCP suspects arrested for roles in a supply chain campaign; SecurityScorecard STRIKE analyzes the worm.

author: cubillas888
text: Check Point: Aokigahara infostealer collects session and config files from AI tools like Claude, Codex and Cursor; revoke AI sessions and rotate keys.
